context: Mei and Aoi chat about chasing a dream.
purpose: Casual register; vocabulary (目指す/恋/乗る/問わ/無く) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 私、いつか自分の店を目指してるの。
lines.en: I'm aiming to have my own shop someday.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 素敵な夢だね。応援するよ。
lines.en: What a lovely dream. I'll support you.
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 勢いに乗って、頑張りたいんだ。
lines.en: I want to ride the momentum and work hard.
lines.style: enthusiastic barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 年齢を問わず、夢は持てるよね。
lines.en: Regardless of age, you can have dreams.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: お金が無くても、工夫すればいいよね。
lines.en: Even without money, you can be resourceful.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 恋も夢も、大事にしたいな。
lines.en: I want to cherish both love and dreams.
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 迷いが無くなったら、すぐ動くよ。
lines.en: Once my doubts are gone, I'll act right away.
lines.style: determined barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 目指す場所が、見えてきたね。
lines.en: The place you're aiming for is coming into view.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm affectionate closing delivery throughout
